name: Disneyland Tiana's Palace Oven-Roasted Half Chicken & Plain Steamed White Rice (Hold Cajun Spice)
brandOrRestaurant: Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Tiana's Palace slow-roasts tender bone-in chicken and has plain steamed white rice behind the counter (used as the base for gumbos and kids' meals); peeling the spiced chicken skin reveals juicy, flare-safe white meat underneath.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Oven-Roasted Chicken (or the Kids' Roasted Chicken & White Rice plate), ask for plain steamed white rice instead of red beans/Carolina spicy rice, and remove the Cajun-seasoned chicken skin before eating.
watchOuts: Always swap out the red beans and spicy rice for plain steamed white rice, and remove the seasoned skin
